in_marathi.name: Chanderpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon, Moon God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chanderpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chanderpal is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Chandra (Moon) and Pal (lord). This name signifies a person who is the lord of the moon or a person who is protected and guided by the moon.
